notes: Formal Fae royal title used for multiple holders, including Titarion and Mathon. English is primary; Japanese 至高王 and Chinese 至高王/大君 corroborate the role. Standardize Korean title wording as 지고왕 and keep personal-name compounds atomic, such as 지고왕 티타리온(High King Titarion). This entry does not merge the office with any ruler as a person.

English identifies Mathon as the former Winter Court ruler and as the holder of the crown later taken by Gadflow. Japanese マトン and Chinese 玛颂 corroborate the name. Standardize Korean variants 마손/마톤 as 마톤(Mathon); keep Mathon distinct from the High King title and from Mathon’s Court as an institution.
